methodology.probationRule: Hire day 1-15 -> ref = 1st of same month; 16-31 -> ref = 1st of next month; probation passes 3 months after ref. Eligible for month M if pass-date <= 1st of M.
methodology.activeRule: Excluded if Last Day of Work (Database Shortcut.xlsx) is on/before the period end; Status field used only when no Last Day is on file.
methodology.curveSheet: medical rep points scheme / SALES REP
methodology.chcCoverageScaling: x4 on the raw 10pt Coverage curve to hit the deck's 40pt weight (flagged, unconfirmed with workbook author)
